title: lfg-identify-caller: Java 11 to Java 21 and AWS SDK for Java 2.x
scenario: The Java Lambda that identifies callers for Larkspur's inbound flow runs on java11 with the AWS SDK for Java 1.x (end of support 2025-12-31) and JUnit 4. Upgrade it to Java 21 and SDK 2.x with SnapStart, keeping its Connect contract and its 3-second budget, without falling into the SDK 2.x semantic change that broke another team's upgrade.
task: Move pom.xml to release 21, the SDK 2.x BOM, a lightweight HTTP client and JUnit 5
Port the handler to DynamoDbClient with the same flat string map contract
Add overrideConfig() timeouts inside the flow budget
Switch infra/function.yaml to java21 with SnapStart on published versions
acceptance: Hidden JUnit 5 tests pass against the SDK 2.x API, including not-found as SDK 2.x reports it
Timeouts within budget; classes compiled for Java 21
No SDK 1.x or JUnit 4 left; java21 + SnapStart in infra
ANSWER.md covers breaking changes, SnapStart caveats and rollout
